story_overview: Tensions escalate among a group of eccentric characters, moving from a retro shag room to a cluttered service corridor. In the corridor, intense conversations unfold between Walter, Julian, Nico, and Simon. The strange events culminate in a ritualistic scene where Leo lies in a bathtub filled with flowers, observed by a concerned Arthur and Walter.

The Shag Room: A bohemian-style retro living room/bedroom interior with wood-paneled walls and a red furry couch with candy wrappers on it.

In the dimly lit The Shag Room, Hector sits dejectedly on the sunken red carpet, wrapped in a blanket and surrounded by wrappers. In the foreground, Walter stands on the right and gestures while speaking. On the left, Nico stands and watches them, his gaze shifting between Walter and Hector.
